clue.text: Cease to have reason to decline

parts.note: to cease to have something is to lose it
grounds are reasons, as in grounds for complaint

explanation.surface: Someone stops having any justification for refusing an offer.
explanation.definitionFit: To fall back or weaken in position is to decline, the sense of the idiom.

clue.text: Dance round after mischievous child

indicators.note: the round letter comes after the child word

parts.note: a limb, short for limb of Satan, is an imp of a child
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: Dancing in a circle after a naughty youngster.
explanation.walkthrough: LIMB, an old British word for a mischievous child (limb of the devil), comes before O.
explanation.definitionFit: The limbo is a Caribbean dance in which one leans back to pass under a low bar.

clue.text: Because bank is in earnest…

parts.note: since means because
to bank on is to rely on

explanation.surface: A bank presented as being in earnest.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links this to 3 down only for the surface: 'sincerely' looks forward to a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Sincerely means genuinely, meaning what one says.

clue.text: … leave town to hold an election

definitions.meaning: depart from the city for rural parts
call a general election and seek the voters' verdict

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means literally to head for rural parts, and in British politics for a prime minister to call a general election.

clue.text: Opportunity for maiden

definitions.meaning: a chance, a gap to exploit
first, as in a maiden voyage

explanation.definitionFit: An opening is a chance or vacancy, and as an adjective means first, inaugural.

clue.text: Author turning up in vehicle "All right, old boy?"

indicators.note: in a down answer turning up reads the assembled letters from bottom to top
the greeting goes inside the vehicle word

parts.note: a van is a vehicle
OK means all right
OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil

explanation.surface: A writer pulls up in a van, greeting a former schoolmate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' reverses the whole assembly, since in a down answer turning up means reading bottom to top; 'old boy' is a former pupil of a school.
explanation.definitionFit: Vladimir Nabokov was the Russian-American writer of Lolita and Pale Fire.

clue.text: Fluster some Conservatives with a U-turn

indicators.note: a U-turn sends the word for the Tories back the way it came, so read it backwards

parts.note: wets were the moderate Conservatives Margaret Thatcher scorned

explanation.surface: A party leader's policy reversal throws some Tory MPs into a panic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with a U-turn' reverses WETS, the 1980s nickname for moderate Conservatives (Tories, a British party), to give the agitated state of 'in a stew'.
explanation.definitionFit: A stew is a state of anxious agitation, as in getting in a stew over something.

clue.text: It's a foolish person that would expect rapid promotion when just starting

indicators.note: only the opening letter of each of the five words is used

explanation.surface: Only an idiot expects a quick rise up the ladder in a new job.
explanation.definitionFit: A twerp is a silly, contemptible person, a nitwit.

clue.text: Saw sense, with ship in distress

parts.note: wit means good sense

indicators.note: the ship letters sit inside the distress word

parts.note: need means hardship or distress
SS stands for steamship

explanation.surface: Someone saw sense when a ship was in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like the verb of 'saw sense'; it alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To witness is to see something happen, so witnessed means saw.

clue.text: Officer does quarrel 'and fall out

indicators.note: to fall out is to scatter or quarrel, so the letters break ranks and reform

explanation.surface: An officer, speaking with a dropped h, tells men to argue and fall out.
explanation.walkthrough: ''and' (and with a dropped h) is fodder; 'fall out' is a parade-ground order.
explanation.definitionFit: A squadron leader is an RAF officer rank, equivalent to a major.

clue.text: Devoured hair-covered sea-creature

indicators.note: the hair is wrapped round the eating word, covering it on both sides

parts.note: a mane is a long growth of hair
devoured means ate

explanation.surface: A hairy sea animal has been eaten.
explanation.definitionFit: The manatee, or sea cow, is a large aquatic mammal of warm coasts.

clue.text: What is left that, in Paris, comes into flower?

indicators.note: the French word enters the middle of the word for the pick of the bunch

parts.note: the flower of something is its best part
que is French for that

explanation.surface: A riddle asking what remains when something in Paris blooms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' looks like a plant; here it is the finest part, BEST, which takes in French QUE.
explanation.definitionFit: A bequest is property left to someone in a will.

clue.text: In public, the strain is more than player bargained for

parts.note: overt means open, done in public
to rick a joint is to strain or sprain it

explanation.surface: Being watched puts a performer under more pressure than expected.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge, a trick taken beyond the number a player contracted (bargained) for is an extra one.
explanation.definitionFit: In bridge, an extra trick won beyond the contract bid is exactly what the declarer did not commit to.

clue.text: Plenty of booze policeman's laid in

indicators.note: the policeman is put down inside the drink word

parts.note: ale is beer, a kind of booze
MP stands for military policeman

explanation.surface: A policeman has stocked up on a good supply of drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Ample means abundant, more than enough.

clue.text: Island featured in mediocre telefilm

indicators.note: the island's letters appear inside the run of the words that follow

explanation.surface: An island shows up as the setting of a poor TV movie.
explanation.definitionFit: Crete is the largest Greek island, in the Mediterranean.

clue.text: A conduit's sabotaged by caretaker

indicators.note: something sabotaged is wrecked, so the letters are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A pipe was wrecked by the building's janitor.
explanation.definitionFit: A custodian is a keeper or guardian of a building or property.

clue.text: Teacher revises verse and song

indicators.note: to revise is to rework, so the letters of the two words are reorganised

explanation.surface: A teacher goes over poetry and music with pupils.
explanation.definitionFit: A governess is a woman employed to teach children in a private household.

clue.text: Sociable person, former partner and rambler, enters race

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse or partner

indicators.note: the wanderer goes into the race letters

parts.note: TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man
a rover is one who wanders

explanation.surface: An outgoing ex and a hiker sign up for a race.
explanation.definitionFit: An extrovert is an outgoing, gregarious type.

clue.text: In island, popular music beginning to take off rapidly

indicators.note: the music word goes inside the name of the Scottish island

parts.note: Skye is an island of the Inner Hebrides
rock is a form of popular music

indicators.note: the opening letter of the following little word is taken

explanation.surface: A music scene on a Scottish island suddenly takes off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take off' looks like a phrasal verb split from 'rapidly', but the three words together are the definition; 'beginning' picks only the first letter of 'to'.
explanation.definitionFit: To shoot up suddenly, like a firework rocket, is to rise very quickly.

clue.text: Citadel where two kings joined forces to subdue a noisy Welshman

indicators.note: in a down answer the kings sit on top of the Welshman, holding him down

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king; R is for rex, Latin king
K is the chess abbreviation for king; R is for rex, Latin king

indicators.note: the name is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: Emlyn is a Welsh man's name

explanation.surface: A fortress where two monarchs unite to quell a loud Welshman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'noisy' turns EMLYN, a Welsh first name, into the sound EMLIN; 'joined forces to subdue' puts K and R above it in the down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Kremlin is the fortified citadel at the heart of Moscow.

clue.text: Measure strength of bird, and speed

parts.note: a tit is a small bird
rate means speed

explanation.surface: Gauging how strong and quick a bird is.
explanation.definitionFit: To titrate is to find the concentration of a chemical solution.

clue.text: Famous saw

explanation.definitionFit: Noted means celebrated or renowned, and also observed or remarked upon, the past of to note.

clue.text: Bulb lit? One in operation

parts.note: a light that is lit is switched on
I is the Roman numeral for one
a machine running is on

explanation.surface: A riddle about whether a light bulb is switched on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bulb' suggests a lamp, as 'lit' encourages; it is the vegetable bulb.
explanation.definitionFit: The onion is a vegetable that grows as an edible bulb.

clue.text: Outside North American Indian set up information for computer

indicators.note: in a down answer set up means read from the bottom upwards
the Indian people's name goes outside the north letter

parts.note: the Tupi are a South American Indian people

explanation.surface: A North American Indian sets up data for a computer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'North American' is split: 'Outside North' puts TUPI round N, and 'set up' reverses TUPNI.
explanation.definitionFit: Input is the data fed into a computer.

clue.text: Dish comprising primarily cuts of tender meat

indicators.note: the dish holds the initials within it

parts.note: an entree is a dish served at a meal

indicators.note: the first letters of the three words are taken

explanation.surface: A dish made mostly from choice cuts of tender meat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'primarily' takes C, O and T from 'cuts of tender', which go inside ENTREE.
explanation.definitionFit: An entrecote is a steak cut from between the ribs of beef.

clue.text: Relieved when a seed sprouts

indicators.note: a seed that sprouts changes shape, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A gardener is relieved when a seed finally germinates.
explanation.definitionFit: Eased means made less painful or troublesome, alleviated.

clue.text: Commanding the dropping of a compromise

indicators.note: the article is let fall out of the commanding word

parts.note: imperial means commanding, majestic

explanation.surface: An order to give up a deal with the other side.
explanation.definitionFit: To imperil is to endanger, the sense of compromise in compromising safety.

clue.text: Skill in speech-making

definitions.meaning: a formal talk delivered to an audience

explanation.definitionFit: Address means adroitness or tact, and also a formal oration given to listeners.

clue.text: Fabric is stated to be free of all deductions

indicators.note: said out loud, the fabric word gives the answer

parts.note: net is a fine open-meshed fabric

explanation.surface: A cloth is declared to be sold with nothing taken off.
explanation.definitionFit: A nett sum is what remains after tax and charges are taken off, the British spelling of net.

clue.text: No time given to cover fall, so failed to appreciate

indicators.note: the undated word goes round the falling word

parts.note: undated means bearing no date
to err is to fall into error or sin

explanation.surface: Not being told the time to cover a tumble leads to someone being overlooked.
explanation.definitionFit: Underrated means valued too low, given less credit than deserved.
